data.title: Redefining the role of AMPK in autophagy and the energy stress response
data.authors: Park JM; Lee DH; Kim DH

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: In cultured cells, AMPK activation under glucose starvation or mitochondrial energy stress inhibited ULK1 and autophagy induction, the opposite of the classic activating reading. AMPK also protected the ULK1 machinery from caspase-mediated degradation.
